title: Temporal KB: bitemporal note nodes (validFrom/validTo + supersede chains + as-of retrieval)
summary: Closes the Zep temporal gap on KB note nodes. Note nodes now carry validFrom/validTo + supersedes/supersededBy; superseding a note stamps the old one's validTo (= new note's validFrom) and chains both directions WITHOUT deleting history. search_knowledge gains as_of (return the fact CURRENT at a past instant, not just the latest) and history (whole timeline); default search hides superseded notes. New supersede_note MCP tool; record_decision gains supersedes/valid_from for one-shot supersede. Dashboard dims superseded notes (🕓) + draws a purple-dashed supersede link. Bench at bench/temporal/ is recall@k/MRR-scored (compatible with the parallel retrieval-quality scorer): a fact that changed (deploy target fly.io→render→railway) scores temporal recall@5=1.0/MRR=1.0 vs latest-only baseline 0.6/0.6 — the as-of queries are exactly what a flat KB misses. Caught + fixed a real latent bug: addNoteNode's Date.now()-only id collided within a millisecond, clobbering back-to-back notes. Built on branch feat/temporal-kb (worktree), HELD for merge — not merged to main.
